reasons.A: Right period diction and measured first-person hedging ('I fancy', 'Granted;'), but sentences are tidier and more aphoristic ('the door is narrower...') than the author's discursive, cumulative build.

reasons.C: Modern, even-toned expository prose ('half the story', 'mix of courses', 'anyone') with little first-person stance or period texture; furthest from the author's voice.
